"""Minimal WSGI application for the eu-central Elastic Beanstalk environment."""
import os

ENVIRONMENT_NAME = "eu-central"
REGION_NAME = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "eu-central-1")

def application(environ, start_response):
    status = "200 OK"
    headers = [("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")]
    body = "Hello from Elastic Beanstalk environment {} in {}!\n".format(
        ENVIRONMENT_NAME, REGION_NAME
    ).encode("utf-8")
    start_response(status, headers)
    return [body]
